Cosmere.Roshar.Def.SurgeDef.label: adhesion
Cosmere.Roshar.Def.SurgeDef.description: The Surge of Adhesion manipulates atmospheric pressure to bind surfaces together on a molecular level. With this power, a Surgebinder can walk on walls, seal doors shut, or create powerful vacuums. Adhesion reflects the pure essence of connection — the fundamental bond between objects and people.
